# Synthetic voice fixtures

Generated locally with FFmpeg's libflite filter, using the built-in `slt` and `kal` speech synthesizers. No user recording or unlicensed impersonation sample is included.

Reference text: "This is an authorized synthetic voice sample for local conversion testing. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."

Source text: "Hello there. This application changes a voice without training."

Flite is Carnegie Mellon University's small runtime speech synthesis engine. Project and permissive source/license notices: https://github.com/festvox/flite . These fixtures are used to validate model execution and timing, not human speaker similarity or Korean quality.
